entities.summary: Tim Bentinck, 12th Earl of Portland (b. 1953-06-01, Tasmania) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tasmania and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
